description: Create a markdown note. Default: a fresh file whose filename is `name` (a name with `/`, `..` or a control character is refused), written into `folder` (default: the vault's new_notes_folder, else the vault ROOT). Set daily:true INSTEAD to resolve-or-create TODAY'S daily note (from the vault's daily_note_format, custom moment.js tokens) and append `content` to it — the canonical "append to today's note" workflow — seeding a brand-new daily note from the configured template first; `name`/`folder` are not accepted with daily:true. For a plain note, if_exists governs a collision: "error" (default — refuse) or "append". Writes atomically, confined to the vault. The response reports the written `path`, `created` (true=new file, false=appended to an existing one), and for a daily note the resolved daily_note_format. dry_run:true resolves the destination WITHOUT writing.

content.description:
Initial note body (plain mode) / the text appended to today's daily
note (`daily`).

daily.description:
When true, resolve-or-create TODAY'S daily note and append `content`
to it instead of creating a titled note.

dry_run.description:
Preview only — resolve the destination + report it WITHOUT writing. The
response carries `dry_run: true`.

folder.description:
Destination folder (vault-relative). Defaults to the vault's
`new_notes_folder`, else the vault root. Not accepted with `daily`.

if_exists.description:
Collision policy for a plain note whose target already exists:
`"error"` (default — refuse) or `"append"`.

name.description:
The note's title, used as the filename; `/`, `..` and control characters are refused. Required for a plain
note; OMIT it with `daily: true` (a daily note's name is date-derived).

name: create_note
